baseUrl.description: Kibana base URL, for example https://kibana.example.com:5601.

skipTlsVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Equivalent to tlsInsecureSkipVerify and insecureSkipVerify; explicitly configured aliases must agree or the request is rejected. Omitted means false.

tlsInsecureSkipVerify.description: Alias for skipTlsVerify. Explicitly configured TLS-skip aliases must agree or the request is rejected. Omitted means false.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Alias for skipTlsVerify. Explicitly configured TLS-skip aliases must agree or the request is rejected. Omitted means false.
